module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Remainder Policy: Round-Robin Rotation Across Sub-Accounts
precondition: 3 equal accounts; 3 consecutive trades generating 0.01 remainder each.
steps: 1. Trade 1: Remainder to Acc 1 (0.34, 0.33, 0.33).2. Trade 2: Remainder to Acc 2 (0.33, 0.34, 0.33).3. Trade 3: Remainder to Acc 3 (0.33, 0.33, 0.34).
expected: Remainder rotating sequentially; perfectly equal cumulative volume across all 3 accounts over time.
coverage_note: No configurable remainder-distribution ledger, rebate ledger, or exact block-allocation policy was available for this requirement.
